format: Markdown task box conformance vectors. Core (__tests__/Markdown.test.ts) and Rust (tests/markdown.rs) run this file. A row is [name, width, conceal, markers, source, frame, then?].

markers is the task box text option (Core's taskMarkers, Rust's task_markers) as { unchecked, checked }, or null to leave it unset. frame is the document drawn width columns wide, each line trimmed at its end.
then, when present, is [markers, frame]: the document streams its source, and after the first frame the option changes while it still streams; frame is the next frame.
rows: conceal shows the boxes the option sets
without conceal the source boxes show
without conceal the option changes nothing
a long item wraps under its text
a change while streaming marks and wraps the items again

- [ ] alpha beta gamma delta epsilon
- [x] b

    delta epsilon
- ☑ b
